title: Normalized scalar package with a fixed cochain model
statement: Let J be a site with additive sheafification, sheaf composition from commutative rings to rings, equivalence of local bijectivity with sheafification equivalences, and essential smallness in the coefficient universe. Let R,S be commutative ring sheaves, phi:R→S and D a DerivedChangeOfRingsCochainModel for phi. There exists a SystemScalarModel A for phi whose model is exactly D. The site object, site Hom and coefficient universes are independent. The definitions and hypotheses are as in [def-weil-pbc-system-scalar-model], [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings].

source.place: Tags 03D7 and 03EK; sites-cohomology.tex 06YY. Exact proof previously private in IntegralComparisonSequenceSystems.

proof.text:
Choose the normalized derived counit comparison using the cochain universal property. The
ordinary tensor/restriction adjunction gives its unique unit-normalized adjunction, and the
derived Hom comparison gives the derived adjunction with the required transpose. The unit sends
x to one tensor x by the ordinary unit formula; this constructs the scalar package without
changing its cochain model.
